title: About Me
text: I am a graduate student pursuing a Master of Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania, with an expected graduation date of December 2027. I earned my Bachelor of Arts in Economics, cum laude, from Boston University in May 2026. My academic and professional interests lie at the intersection of economics, finance, and data analytics. Through internships in business analytics, energy market research, banking, and securities research, I have gained experience applying quantitative methods to real-world business and financial questions.

title: About Me
text:
Career Goals
My goal is to pursue a career as a financial research analyst, business analyst, or data analyst. I am particularly interested in roles where I can combine economic reasoning, quantitative analysis, and industry research to identify meaningful patterns, evaluate market or business performance, and support evidence-based decision-making.
